bio.text: Robb Tucker is the Republican candidate for California's 3rd Congressional District in 2026.
According to his campaign website, he was elected to the Nevada County Board of Supervisors in 2024, was born in Nevada County, and graduated from Bear River High School.
The site says he holds a bachelor's degree in business administration from Pepperdine University and a master's degree from Wheaton College Graduate School, and lives in south Nevada County.
It also says he was president and CEO of a family business that owned Forest Springs Mobilehome Community until selling it in 2020.
